description: One settlement event per cycle, per agent. The only way an agent's budget gains credit. Requires an external_grader — internal self-grading is forbidden at type-level. PASS grants credit scaled to ratchet_delta (capped). FAIL grants 0 credit. NO_VERDICT grants 0 credit (abstain; never self-grade when no external source is available).

cycle_id.description: Identifier of the cycle being settled.

agent_id.description: Agent whose budget is being credited. Per-agent settlements only — no inter-agent credit transfer.

external_grader.description: REQUIRED. Which external source graded this cycle. Enum is an explicit allow-list — the chain rejects any value not in this set. Internal agents cannot appear here. Self-grading is structurally impossible at the type layer.

outcome.description: External grader's ruling. PASS = externally-verified working ship; credit > 0. FAIL = externally corrected; credit = 0 (optional penalty applied to next cycle's opening). NO_VERDICT = no external source available this cycle; credit = 0; abstain. NO_VERDICT is first-class: when there is no grader, the agent does not self-grade.

credit.description: Credit awarded by this settlement. PASS → credit > 0 (scaled to ratchet_delta, configured cap). FAIL → 0. NO_VERDICT → 0. credit MUST be 0 unless outcome = PASS — enforced at chain write-time.

ratchet_delta.description: Externally-observed ratchet movement this settlement attributes to the cycle (signed). null when outcome != PASS. Used to scale credit. Examples: PR merged + tests pass = +1; held-out-task scored as solved = +1; user reported working = +1.

per_channel_credit.description: OPTIONAL multi-channel credit breakdown. When omitted, all credit is implicitly the 'compute' channel and scalar `credit` is authoritative. When present, keys are channel names matching budget-state.per_channel; values are non-negative numbers; sum-across-channels = scalar credit. A PASS can credit channels asymmetrically — e.g. a shipped+verified artifact credits `ratchet` heavily but does not refund `energy` spent. Each channel has its own credit function: ratchet ← durable-capability-added; compute ← token-budget-refund-fraction; energy ← grid-mix-clean-credit; attention ← human-time-saved-via-automation; correction_tax ← negative-correction-rate-trend.

evidence_uri.description: URI to the artifact that proves the external settlement — link to PR, audit log, user response transcript, OTS-stamp. Settlement without evidence is chain-invalid. For NO_VERDICT this is the audit note explaining why no external source was available. SEEK fills this slot.

ledger_window_start_sha.description: sha_seal of the first chain event this settlement covers (the cycle's first event for this agent).

ledger_window_end_sha.description: sha_seal of the last chain event this settlement covers (the cycle's last event before settlement).

shipped_artifact_count.description: Cheap-and-shipped gate: PASS with shipped_artifact_count = 0 is forbidden. Cheap-AND-verified is the optimum; merely cheap with no ship earns no credit.

recorded_by.description: Agent that recorded the settlement event (NOT the external grader — the grader identity is in evidence_uri / external_grader).

derived_from_shas.description: Cause-effect lineage. sha_seals of chain events this settlement covers beyond the immediate ledger_window. Multi-input causation: a settlement derived from N agent-events references all N. Enables backward walk: which registrations / predictions caused this settlement?
